messages:
alex: FYI — merge window for release v2.4 opens in ~2h. Please bump versions in any PRs that change packages, add a short changelog entry, and make sure CI is green before the window closes. Ping me for backports or cherry-picks. @jamie @maria

jamie: Quick q — what's the exact freeze cutoff? If a PR is still in review at cutoff, do we cherry-pick into the release branch or defer to the next minor?

maria: Cutoff = 1h before tagging (so ~1h from now). After cutoff we only accept hotfix/cherry-pick PRs into release/v2.4.0. Non-critical stuff goes in next minor. Minimal release checklist: bump VERSION, add entry under changelogs/unreleased.md, run local smoke + unit tests. Example local commands:
```bash
./scripts/local-smoke.sh
pytest -k 'not slow'
```

jamie: Got it. A couple of my PRs are flaking on CI: `test_stream_timeout` and `test_kv_cache_race`. Any quick triage suggestions?

tay: I'll take the flaky ones. For `test_stream_timeout` you can repro locally with:
```bash
pytest tests/e2e/test_stream.py::test_stream_timeout -q -s
```
Often it's an environment timing issue — sometimes increasing the test timeout or adding a small retry is fastest. If I can't fix in ~30m I'll open a draft PR to xfail/mark flaky and follow up with a real fix.

ci-bot: Build #5892 for branch feature/async-batch failed: 3 flaky failures detected. Reports: https://ci.internal/reports/5892. Failing tests: tests/e2e/test_stream.py::test_stream_timeout (x2), tests/unit/test_kv.py::test_kv_cache_race

ops-bot: :warning: deploy pipeline scheduled for release tag creation at 1747004722 (~2h). Ensure all required checks pass before then.

alex: :thumbsup: Thanks. jamie — please rebase & push. If CI keeps failing on flake, either add a temporary xfail with an issue link or ask tay for a hotfix. Hotfix workflow: cherry-pick commit onto release/v2.4.0 and open a backport PR.

jamie: Clarifying — do we want version bumps in each package PR, or do a single version bump in a release PR?

maria: Prefer version bump in the package PR that introduces the change. The release tag uses `release-manifest.yaml` to assemble package versions; if someone forgets we can do a final bump on the release branch but that's last resort.

tay: Draft PR opened to mark `test_stream_timeout` xfail with issue reference: https://git.internal/pulls/1245 — will revert once fixed. If maintainers prefer, I'll instead add a small retry wrapper.

alex: For hotfixes remember the command:
```bash
git checkout release/v2.4.0 && git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha> && git push origin release/v2.4.0
```
I'll be available during the merge window to review and merge on behalf of folks if needed.

jamie: Rebased & pushed. CI triggered: https://ci.internal/build/5901

ci-bot: Build #5901 queued. Queue length: 4. ETA ~12m.

maria: I'll do a quick pass on changelog entries and nudge reviewers for any missing ones. If you want me to merge after green, ping @maria and I'll do the merge for you.

alex: Thanks everyone — keep updates here if you hit blockers, otherwise we'll aim to tag on time.
